test_title: PYST 33: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'LABOUR' is written as 'XZSECM' and ‘GAINED’ is written as ‘JJRLCH’. How will 'EARNED' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : ​Number according to the position of letter within the word is added to the position value according to the English alphabetic series diagonally.

 
• First letter → (+1) is added
 
• Second letter → (+2) is added
 
• Third letter → (+3) is added
 
• Fourth letter → (+4) is added
 
• Fifth letter → (+5) is added
 
• Sixth letter → (+6) is added

​So,

 
• 'LABOUR' is written as 'XZSECM'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c4a99eafdc6b3f3d172588e35902fbdf65bd43d7b05c95d21f93e878e7d3710f.png] 

​And,

 
• ‘GAINED’ is written as ‘JJRLCH’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce8e0532a84183cd526dcb4ee4e7f01434314429c2f5666265701b588924aa8e.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'EARNED' is written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc1ef8373608ae0679b60f568667595cb6db0916cb65dfa61b9d957d0f39592c.png] 

Hence, "**JJRUCF**" is the correct answer.
